method.description: Record package TOTAL PSS on the module grid, open Expense and settle, return to the module grid, request Android foreground memory trim once, settle, and repeat the complete open/close sequence once.
method.limitation: This is an external ADB diagnostic. It is not the signed, source-bound SAAGAR_A10_DEVICE_RUNTIME_ACCEPTANCE producer required by the audit runner.

auditCheckStatus.reason: The diagnostic is healthy, but external ADB readings cannot satisfy the audit runner's compatible-instrumentation, APK-binding and owner-acceptance envelope.

nonClaims: Does not substitute for staff UAT, production signing or release approval.
Does not prove behavior on an API-23-class/OEM device.
